post.caption: 5 AI projects launched in the last 10 days with 19,000+ GitHub stars between them. What each one does, and the catch, in the pinned comment.
post.pinned_comment: Links + catches: 1) universal-modder github.com/rehan-remade/universal-modder (art/3D/sound via fal = paid credits; check your game's EULA). 2) OpenDots github.com/CopilotKit/OpenDots (template, early dev; chats need CopilotKit Intelligence, hosted or local Docker eval). 3) Coucou github.com/Louis-CFM/coucou. 4) RemoveMacAI github.com/omlahore/RemoveMacAI. 5) VibeWise github.com/nykooi1/vibe-wise. Stars as of 7 Oct 2026.
